description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. The project currently targets .NET Framework 4.8, which is a legacy framework with no cross-platform support and limited modern API availability. Upgrading to .NET 10.0 LTS provides long-term support, cross-platform capability, improved performance, and full compatibility with modern Azure SDK packages.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the WebApp-Storage-DotNet project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0. This includes: converting the legacy non-SDK-style project file to SDK-style format; migrating from ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web-based) to ASP.NET Core MVC; removing System.Web dependencies and replacing with ASP.NET Core equivalents; migrating Web.config configuration to ASP.NET Core appsettings.json and Program.cs patterns; updating all NuGet packages to versions compatible with net10.0; and fixing any API compatibility issues between .NET Framework and .NET 10.
